title: Ah correte al giardino
subtitle: Dorabella and Don Alfonso: recitative from Così fan tutte, Act 2

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 2 scene 3, recitative after No. 20
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Così fan tutte (1790)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (giardino with no comma; ragazze, allegria, musica and canto with commas where the libretto has exclamation marks).

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 223 (systems 3–5), the recitative between No. 20 and No. 21 (9 bars)
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed page: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). Where the print gives a second rhythm for the German words (bar 5, “co-lo”), the Italian rhythm is kept. The German singing translation is left out. Fiordiligi is on stage but sings nothing here, and the print gives her no staff: the transcription's empty Fiordiligi staff is left out. It ends “segue Nr. 21 Duett mit Chor”. Playback tempo: Free, as recitative is sung: played here at a speaking pace, ♩ = 100, estimated (Jacobs times this recitative together with No. 21; about ½ minute).

licences.source: Written for this app (from the app's reviewed Così libretto drafts)
